senses.definition: (transitive) to amuse (someone); to engage the attention of agreeably
examples: to entertain friends with lively conversation
The motivational speaker not only instructed but also entertained the audience.

senses.definition: (transitive and intransitive) To have someone over at one's home, or some other venue, for a party or visit.

senses.definition: (transitive) to receive and take into consideration; to have a thought in mind
examples: The committee would like to entertain the idea of reducing the budget figures.

quotes.text: I am not here going to entertain so large a theme as the philosophy of Locke.
A rumour gained ground, — and, however absurd, was entertained by some very sensible people.
